title: Baby Moses Is Protected
summary: God can protect His people through brave and caring choices. Baby Moses Is Protected gives kids a concrete picture of courage instead of only a word to memorize. Moses was protected when his family had to be brave.

read_it.prompt: Read Exodus 2:1-10. Look for what God does and how people respond.

tell_it: Moses was protected when his family had to be brave. Moses' family hid him, placed him in a basket, and trusted God. Pharaoh's daughter found him and cared for him. The pressure in the scene helps the lesson feel real.
understand_it: Baby Moses Is Protected teaches through a concrete moment: a person chooses, God acts, and the result shows what matters. God can protect His people through brave and caring choices.
age_5_7_explanation: Moses was protected when his family had to be brave.
age_8_11_explanation: Moses' family hid him, placed him in a basket, and trusted God. Pharaoh's daughter found him and cared for him. Kids can practice retelling it with the beginning, hard moment, and God-centered ending.
teen_explanation: God can protect His people through brave and caring choices. A teen discussion can press into why the story mattered then and how the same truth can reshape choices now.
key_truths: God can protect His people through brave and caring choices.
Baby Moses Is Protected shows courage through a real Bible moment, not a slogan.
When doing the right thing feels risky, this story shows that small faithful actions can matter in a dangerous world.
life_application: When doing the right thing feels risky, this story shows that small faithful actions can matter in a dangerous world.

quiz_questions.question: Which answer keeps Baby Moses Is Protected connected to the actual passage?
quiz_questions.explanation: In a basket is the story detail to remember. The bigger lesson grows out of that detail instead of floating away from the passage.

quiz_questions.question: Name the pressure, problem, or need in Baby Moses Is Protected.
quiz_questions.answer: Answers should name the story's real challenge and connect it to God's response.
quiz_questions.explanation: Good retelling notices what was hard before jumping straight to the takeaway.

memory_verse.prompt: Let Exodus 2:3 be the short line kids can carry after the activity is over.

discussion_questions: Who needed help, courage, correction, or mercy in Baby Moses Is Protected?
What truth should a kid remember after reading Baby Moses Is Protected?
How can the group pray about Baby Moses Is Protected without using pretend-perfect answers?

activity.title: Basket of Courage
activity.instructions: Fold a paper basket and place inside it three brave choices Moses' family made.

prayer_prompt: Lord, use Baby Moses Is Protected to teach my heart, not just my memory. Help me take one faithful next step after reading Baby Moses Is Protected.
